title: Recover 44 connector searches
prompt:
Finish the 44 technical/unfinished free-knowledge connectors for ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web. Actively work each run and resume saved progress; do not stop after a fixed number of sources.

Use research/free-content-discovery-expansion in its isolated worktree. Fetch first; read AGENTS.md, docs/STATUS.md, registry/goal.json, registry/technical-recovery-goal.json and connector-status.json under docs/research/free-content/. The 44-item list is fixed; two were already Working when this goal began. Prioritize unchecked items and plausible documented alternatives.

Make real supported searches return relevant items. Fix parser/request mistakes, use documented public APIs/exports/search forms, and retry temporary failures with backoff when justified. Save cause, request, result, examples, scope and next action. A blocked attempt is not completion. Do not bypass access controls/robots, pay, create accounts, send outreach, download bulk books/audio or collect personal-owner data.

Check locks, process command/zombie state and remote freshness before any writer. Never duplicate an active collector or force push. Preserve failed evidence and unrelated changes. Run capture, index, audit, registry validation and relevant tests; commit/push small checkpoints. Keep technical-recovery-goal.json and connector-status JSON/CSV current. This continuation is research only; do not activate or deploy sources.

Report every run: the six-group Working | Blocked/failed | Still checking | Total table; progress for the original44; newly fixed connectors; remaining blocker causes/actions; next work and a status-list link. Keep working across runs until all44 have evidence-backed working searches, or the owner accepts/stops remaining work. The old completed documentation queue and its disabled status reporter must stay stopped. Do not claim the native chat Goal UI was activated.
resumed_reason: Owner requested active completion of the original 44 technical/unfinished connectors; previous reporter stays disabled.
